comment: THE IDENTITY GRAMMAR, AS A SHARED TABLE (009 P1-5).
Two boundaries decide whether a name may become part of a DAG name and a
registry path: `registry.identity_fault()` in Python, and the `project`
option's assertion in `modules/devenv.nix`. CONCEPT.md §3.1 says what the
two interfaces share must be TEXT, so a shared table is charter-compatible
tests/conformance/            the pinned dagu accepts every valid name
flake.nix identity-grammar    the Nix-side pattern agrees with `valid`
The grammar is ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$, and the character set is
measured rather than chosen: Dagu 2.15.0 allows alphanumerics, dashes, dots
and underscores in a name and refuses everything else (S-11). The leading
character is restricted further, so that `-flag` and `.hidden` cannot be
`kind` is `project` or `workflow`. A workflow name may hold no dot at all —
that is `dag_name_fault()`, an ADDITIONAL rule with its own injectivity
argument (§9.2), and it is not part of this grammar.

cases.name: devman
cases.why: the ordinary case

cases.name: loci.nvim
cases.why: a real project name on this machine; a project name may hold dots

cases.name: flora-core
cases.why: a dash is in the measured set, and is already in use inside project names

cases.name: templateer_v2
cases.why: an underscore is in the measured set

cases.name: a
cases.why: one character is a name

cases.name: A1
cases.why: case is not constrained

cases.name: 1project
cases.why: a digit may lead; only punctuation may not

cases.name: a.b-c_d
cases.why: every allowed character together
an empty name selects the registry directory itself
selects the registry entry's own directory
selects the registry's parent — the path traversal this grammar exists to refuse

cases.name: -flag
cases.why: a leading dash reads as an option to every command that takes the name

cases.name: .hidden
cases.why: a leading dot hides the registry entry from an ordinary listing

cases.name: a/b
cases.why: a path separator selects a registry subpath

cases.name: a\b
cases.why: a backslash is outside the measured set

cases.name: a b
cases.why: a space is outside the measured set Dagu accepts (S-11)

cases.name: bad@project
cases.why: the review's case: it registered, and the pinned Dagu refuses the DAG name it renders

cases.name: a:b
cases.why: a colon is outside the measured set

cases.name: a	b
cases.why: a control character in a name is never intended

cases.name: café
cases.why: non-ASCII is outside the measured set (S-11)
